decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (BAL-1255(01), BAL-1255(02) and Design and Access Statement [received on 6 June 2018], and Location Plan [received on 2 July 2018]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the outbuilding hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall match those used on the main house

Condition : 5 - The premises shall be used as a gym, storage space and W/C incidental to the use of the house at 45 Gladstone Avenue for no other purpose and shall not be used as residential accommodation or for business purposes.
description: Erection of a detached outbuilding in rear garden
